name: state
notes: solver state as a language: an embedded btor2 model plus claims that carry their own checking plans (reached-bound, safe-invariant, invariant, obligation). Derived over btor2 — registered with the exact embedding pair state--btor2 — and the model evaluator is btor2@2's, transcribed (the lineage says so; this entry never corroborates that family). Claims may carry a 'new' mark: extends_sha hashes the unmarked inherited base, claims_sha hashes everything, and a strengthening pair's square compares source claims_sha to target extends_sha via its manifest maps — document conservativity policed the way the registry polices revisions. The checkable fragment is enumerable models (ENUM_CAP free bits per one-step check, WORK_CAP evaluations per sweep); anything outside it, malformed, or unknown is refused, never guessed.
